description: Verifies the relativistic rocket in flat spacetime: constant proper acceleration against the closed-form hyperbolic solution in proper-time flow, the coordinate-time flow mode, and an exact quarter-turn rotation that preserves the orthonormality of the tetrad.

checks.label: the coordinate time equals sinh(a tau) / a
the proper time matches the hyperbolic solution
the velocity matches the hyperbolic solution
the position matches the hyperbolic solution
the Lorentz factor matches the hyperbolic solution
two thousand steps of 0.001 advance the coordinate time by 2
the velocity matches the hyperbolic solution in coordinate-time flow
a quarter turn removes the x component of the first spatial leg
a quarter turn aligns the first spatial leg with the z axis
